RAJYA   SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the April 23, 2002/Vaisakha 3, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Civil Aviation; Commerce and Industry; Finance; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Tourism and Culture; Water Resources)
Total Number of questions—20
128
Decline in industrial  growth
*421. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that one of the
reasons for decline in industrial growth is
diversion of a considerable part of
budgetary resources from investment to
consumption; and
(b) in what manner industrial growth
can be achieved this year viz-a-viz last
year?
Ban on import of coconut
*422. SHRI H.K. JAVARE GOWDA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that large scale
import of coconut and its products has
caused price crash in Karnataka and other
States; if so, the details thereof;
(b) whether the State Government of
Karnataka has requested Government to
ban the import of coconut and its products;
and
(c) if so, the details of the steps taken
so far in this regard?
Service tax regime
*423. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the service
tax regime is set to go on-line;
(b) whether it is also a fact that it has
been introduced on an experimental basis
in Mumbai;
(c) whether any study has been carried
out in this regard; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Clearance to pending projects
*424. SHRIMATI SARLA MAHESH-
WARI: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION  be pleased to state:
(a) what is the number of projects
pending with the Central Government for
clearance, State-wise;
(b) what is the duration of their
pendency, project-wise; and
(c) what are the reasons therefor?

WIN2\SESSION\193RS 129
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Funds for development of tourism in
Uttar Pradesh
†*425. SHRI MUNAVVAR HASAN:
Will the Minister of TOURISM AND
CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal for allocation of more funds for
development of tourist places/places of
pilgrimage of Uttar Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Diamond export
†*426. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have fixed
target of 60 per cent share in the world
diamond market by 2005;
(b) if so, the strategy adopted to
achieve this target; and
(c) the new facilities proposed to be
provided to the exporters in order to boost
the export of diamonds and jewels?
Interest rates on deposits in
Urban Co-operative Banks
*427. SHRI YADLAPATI VENKAT
RAO : Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Reserve Bank of India
has issued a directive to the Urban Co-
operative banks to slash the interest rates
on deposits to the level offered by the
commercial banks;
(b) if so, the rate of interest Urban Co-
operative banks were paying before the
directive of the RBI; and
(c) what is the rate of interest of
commercial banks at present?
Import duty exemption on appliances
for disabled
*428. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether a delegation of disabled
persons recently met him seeking
exemption of import duty and taxes on
appliances meant for them;
(b) whether it is a fact that these
specific budgetary demands are being
made by them for the last several years;
and
(c) if so, the details of demand made
togetherwith the action taken on each of
them?
Production cost of crude oil
†*429. SHRI RAJIV RANJAN
SINGH 'LALAN':
SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
 Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have assessed
the production cost of crude oil being
produced in various parts of the country;
(b) if so, what was the average
production cost of crude oil produced in
various parts of the country during
1999-2000, 2000-2001 and 2001-2002;
and
(c) the year-wise landed cost of
imported crude oil in India during the
above period?

130
WIN2\SESSION\193RS 130
Duty and tax relief on petroleum
products
*430. SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
SHRI BHAGATRAM
MANHAR:
 Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Oil
companies in India will find it difficult to
retain prices of petroleum products at
current level in case the increase in crude
prices is not offset by duty and tax relief
by Government;
(b) if so, whether Government propose
to come to the rescue of oil companies;
and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Profit earned by AI
*431.  SHRI SANJAY NIRUPAM:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Air India has made any
profit for the year 2001-2002;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Air India has made any
profit from non-operating revenue or its
unutilised bilateral rights; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Export growth target
*432. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the export growth target
has been slashed by 12 per cent for the
current fiscal year as against the
previously achieved growth rate of 19.83
per cent in 2000-2001;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the country's targeted International
share (in terms of percentage) for
2000-2001;
(d) the share (in terms of percentage)
of "ores and minerals" in India's total
export in 2000-2001 and the projection
for the current year; and
(e) whether any study is made to
qualify the improvement in export growth
rate by exporting value added products of
these "ores and minerals" instead of
exporting them as it is?
Import and Export of petroleum
products
†*433. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
 Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that imports and
exports of various petroleum products
have been made during the last three
years;
(b) if so, the names of these petroleum
products  togetherwith their quantities and
prices at which they were imported and
exported during 1999-2000,
2000-2001 and 2001-2002; and
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
international prices during abovesaid
years, especially of petrol and diesel were
less than their consumer prices in India;
if so, the details thereof?
Withdrawal of subsidy to North-East
passengers
*434. SHRI DRUPAD BORGOHAIN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that subsidy
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

131
WIN2\SESSION\193RS 131
given to passengers of North-East in air
travel  has been withdrawn;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
fare hike to and fro North-East
destinations are much higher than any
other sector now; and
(c) if so, what has forced the Ministry
of Civil Aviation to do so?
Report of S.S. Kohli Committee of
RBI
*435. SHRI AMAR SINGH: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that S.S. Kohli
Committee appointed by RBI to identify
and define wilful defaulter has submitted
its report;
(b) if so, the salient features thereof;
and
(c) what action has been taken by
Government thereon?
Allotment of petrol pumps to widows
of Defence Personnel and disabled
soldiers
*436. SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
SHRI SURESH KALMADI:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
Government’s scheme to allot petrol
pumps to widows of Defence Personnel
and disabled soldiers has failed to yield
desired results due to refusal to give land
and NOC, by State Governments for
setting up the petrol pumps;
(b) if so, the details of such pending
cases including the number of persons to
whom the letter of intent has been issued
by the petroleum companies and the
reasons for the refusal to allot land and
issuing NOCs; and
(c) the steps being considered to assure
them a dignified life by implementing the
scheme properly?
Promotion for Programmer-cum-
Operators in State Bank of Bikaner
and Jaipur
*437. SHRI SHYAM LAL: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) the total employees promoted as
Programmer-cum-Operators and
JMGS-I separately till date from
backward staff and others by State Bank
of Bikaner and Jaipur during the last three
years;
(b) the number of SC/ST promoted and
the details of backlog available in (a)
above;
(c) the number of SC/ST awaiting
promotion after getting 120 hours of
Computer Training;
(d) whether experience/standard has
been relaxed for SC/ST on both posts; and
(e) the steps proposed to be taken to
fill up backlog as per DOPT order dated
the 21st January, 2002?
Effect of LTC ban on tourism
*438. SHRI K.M. KHAN: Will the
Minister of TOURISM AND CULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that ban on LIC
(Leave Travel Concession) to the Central
Government employees and other
Government Organisations has badly hit
the domestic tourism industry;
(b) if so, the extent of business affected
in this regard;

132
WIN2\SESSION\193RS 132
(c) whether it is also a fact that some
State Governments including Ministry of
Tourism have demanded/requested for
restoration of LTC to the Central
Government employees; and
(d) if so, what is the Government’s
response thereto?
Modifications in AI’s Boeing 747-400
aircrafts
*439. SHRI SURESH KALMADI:
SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Air India employed a
Taiwanese agency, Egat, to carry out
modifications on three Boeing 747-400
aircrafts;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that these
modifications could have been carried out
by engineers of the Air India; and
(d) if so, the reasons for not utilising
the services of Air India engineers?
ADB loan for drinking
water in Bihar
*440. SHRI PARMESHWAR
KUMAR AGARWALLA: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Asian Development Bank
has given any loan or grant to Bihar during
the last two years for providing drinking
water in villages of all the districts of the
State;
(b) if so, the villages/districts
identified for the purpose;
(c) the quantum of funds allocated to
each village/district; and
(d) the progress made so far, district-
wise?

Retirement age of air hostesses
3079. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR
REDDY: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that some time
back, the Supreme Court of India
pronounced a judgement ruling that the air
hostesses employed in Air India should be
assigned flying air hostesses duties till the
age of 58 years instead of 45;
(b) if so, whether Government have
started implementing the decision;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) whether any guidelines have been
put in place specifying the health and fitness
standards for such duties and if so, the
details thereof?
Expansion of Dibrugarh Airport
3080. SHRI DRUPAD BORGOHAIN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) what are the reasons for neglecting
expansion of Dibrugarh Airport lounges,
which are very much congested in
comparison to the number of passengers;
and
(b) whether Government would consider
to improve the airport upto international
standard in near future?
Encroachments around airports
3081. SHRI R.P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that most of the
airports including some premiere ones like
Mumbai are surrounded by sprawling
encroachments even right upto the perimeter
wall posing serious hazard to air traffic and
avoidable security threat; and
(b) if so, the details of the problems faced
at different airports and the action taken/
proposed to be taken to remove these
encroachments with their present status?
Revision of pay scales of IA/AA
ground staff
3082. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the ground staff working in
Indian Airlines and Alliance Air are provided
other different pay scales/structure for the
same work/job;

673
WIN2\SESSION\195RS-QUES 673
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is a fact that the salary of
staff other than ground staff has been
revised in Alliance Air; and
(d) if so, the reasons for not revising the
pay structure of ground staff?
Operational facilities to foreign airlines
3083. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR
REDDY: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item captioned
"Cruise Control : Government restrictions
make foreign airlines think twice before
setting up shop in India" which appeared in
the Hindustan Times dated the 17th March,
2002;
(b) if so, what is Government's reaction
thereto; and
(c) the steps proposed to be taken in this
regard to create favourable conditions for
the foreign airlines to operate?
IA services to Hong Kong and Saudi
Arabia
3084. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Indian Airlines are
contemplating to start its services to Hong
Kong and Saudi Arabia;
(b) whether Government have
sanctioned these flights; and
(c) if so, the details in this regard?
Training to Pilots
3085. PROF. M. SANKARA-
LINGAM: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal to send pilots to England for
training;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have entered
into any negotiations in this regard; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Security Hazard at Mumbai Airport
3086. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
SHRI YADLAPATI VENKAT
RAO:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether slums around the Mumbai
airport are a great security hazard;
(b) if so, the steps proposed to be taken
to clear at least fifty feet area outside the
boundary wall of the slums;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
Security of Mumbai Airport could be
breached from slums surrounding the
Airport; and
(d) the steps taken to make Mumbai
Airport safe?
Installation of DVOR at Jabalpur
Airport
†3087. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the reasons for not giving OK
certificate so far to DVOR installed at
Jabalpur Airport togetherwith the reasons
for the delay in this regard;

WIN2\SESSION\195RS-QUES 674
(b) whether any proposal to install ILS
category equipments at this airport is under
the consideration of Government;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) by when Government propose to give
the said certificate?
Review of safety norms
3088. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have constituted a High Powered Committee
to review the safety norms, etc., followed
by private operators of chartered aircraft;
(b) if so, the details thereof and whether
the Committee has submitted its report; and
(c) if so, what are the recommendations
of the Committee?
Norms for expansion of fleet
3089. SHRI N.K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) the number of Aircrafts above ten
years old used by the Airlines companies in
India;
(b) whether there are any proposal with
the Airlines companies to replace their
ageing fleet;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether any norms are maintained
for the expansion of fleet; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Rehabilitation of slum dwellers around
Mumbai Airport
3090. SHRI SANJAY NIRUPAM: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry of Civil Aviation
has removed a number of slums from its
encroached land in Mumbai recently;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the Ministry has any plan to
rehabilitate those removed slum dwellers;
and
(d) if so, what is the status of the
rehabilitation?
Air connectivity
†3091. SHRI JANESHWAR MISHRA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Air India,
Indian Airlines and private sector airways
have been unable to connect the country by
air so far;
(b) whether it is also a fact that there
have been some policy related reasons
behind this;
(c) whether it is also a fact that it will be
beneficial if Ministry of Tourism and Culture
and Ministry of Civil Aviation sign an
agreement to act together under a common
policy development scheme; and
(d) the criteria Government would adopt

their purchase?
Air services from Srinagar for Haj
Pilgrims

the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have started a direct flight for Haj
Pilgrimages from Srinagar to Jeddah Sharif;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

675
WIN2\SESSION\195RS-QUES 675
(b) whether it is also a fact that 40 per
cent Muslim population of Jammu Province
is deprived of this facility;
(c) if so, whether Government will start
such a direct flight for Hajis from Jammu to
Jeddah Sharif from next year; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Service condition of employees of AI
3093. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) the total number of permanent

of 55 to 58;

(d) if so, how many of them were laid
off in the first half of this financial year?
Regularisation of ground staff in AA
3094. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the ground staff employed
in Alliance Air has not been regularised even
after four years;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether the promotion of various
categories of ground staff employees is also
pending for a long time; and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor?
Clearance of encroachments around
airports
3095. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR
REDDY: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item captioned
"Plane Truth: Soon a cow on the runway"
which appeared in the Times of India dated
17th March, 2002;
(b) if so, what is Government's reaction
thereto; and
(c) the measures proposed to be adopted
to clear the encroachments in the various
airports in the country as highlighted in the
news-item which are proving serious
security hazards?
IA package to Andhra Pradesh
3096. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Indian Airlines has offered
any package to the Government of Andhra
Pradesh which will promote tourism here
in coordination with Indian Airlines;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) what is the State Government's
reaction in that regard; and
(d) what is the present status of the
package?
International flights from Hyderabad
Airport
3097. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether airlines of UK, Switzerland,
Singapore and Sri Lanka have shown
interest to operate their flights to and from
Hyderabad Airport;

676
WIN2\SESSION\195RS-QUES 676
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government propose to
grant permission to these airlines to start
their flights; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Losses due to open sky policy
3098. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether open sky policy to tide over
the capacity crunch as a short term solution
is causing loss of Rs. 15,000 crores with 40
international flights discontinuing operation;
(b) whether Welcome Travels owns a
sum of about Rs. 3 crores paid to them
during 1997-98 because of excess
commission by Air India; and
(c) if so, the steps being taken by
Government on both the issues?
Permission to private vehicles in the
operational area
3099. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that VIP passengers
are now taking their personal vehicles into
the operational area at Indira Gandhi
International Airport thus flouting airport
security;
(b) whether it is also a fact that permitting
such vehicles into the operational area can
lead to a major accident for obvious reasons;
and
(c) if so, what steps are being taken by
Government to strictly enforce the airport
security rules?
Modernisation of airport at Madurai
3100. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of funds allocated for
expansion/modernisation of airport at
Madurai;
(b) what is the progress of work; and
(c) by when the work will be completed?
DGCA as a regulator for airlines
3101. SHRI R.P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a proposal has
been formulated to convert the Directorate
General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) into an
independent regulator for the airline sector;
and
(b) if so, the details thereof, including
the structure and scope of activities and
responsibilities of the regulator, especially
those relating to technical and economic
issues and its present status?
Losses due to non-operation of flights
to Pakistan
†3102. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the names of the flights which
operated via Pakistan and the names of the
flights of Pakistan which operated via India
prior to 1st January, 2002;
(b) whether Government have imposed
ban on the flights bound for the other country
passing through Pakistan w.e.f. 1st January,
2002; and
(c) if so, the alternative measures taken
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

677
WIN2\SESSION\195RS-QUES 677
by Government and the additional financial
burden likely to be borne by the passengers?
Purchase of Westland Helicopters
3103. SHRI SWARAJ KAUSHAL:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the total loss suffered by the country
on account of purchase of Westland
Helicopters;
(b) whether an enquiry was conducted
for the defective purchase;
(c) if so, the persons held responsible
for the defective purchase;
(d) if not, the reasons for not conducting
an enquiry;
(e) whether Government took up the
matter with the British Government for sale
of poor quality helicopters and what was
their response; and
(f) the action proposed to be taken by
Government to avoid similar loss in future?
New Trade Fair Centres in Rajasthan
3104. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to set
up New Trade Fair Centres in Rajasthan;
and
(b) if so, what will be the total cost of the
project and the speciality of these centres?
Loss of exporting capacity
†3105. SHRI JANESHWAR MISHRA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that due to the new
Exim policy declared on the advice of World
Trade Organisation our exporters will be
failed as compared to large exporters of the
world and our exporting capacity will be
lost and on the other hand in the name of
import due to capturing the market by foreign
investors we will be fully dependant on
imports and our production will also suffer;
(b) if so, what is Government's reaction
in this regard; and
(c) whether the country will be
economically slave as a result thereof?
Export of key products
†3106. SHRI JANESHWAR MISHRA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have not been able to locate the markets for
the exports of the products of the key sectors
of the country due to which the nation has
to incur heavy losses;
(b) whether it is also a fact that
Government have failed to export the
agricultural produce of the country due to
which that peasants have to incur heavy loss;
and
(c) by when Government will be able to
export the key products of the country?
Impact of Exim Policy

RAO: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the overall impact of the Exim Policy
2001; and
(b) to what extent exporters have been
benefited by the policy?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

678
WIN2\SESSION\195RS-QUES 678
Export of wheat
3108. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the quantity of wheat exported during
the last fiscal year;
(b) the amount of foreign exchange
earned by the deal; and
(c) whether it has upgraded India's
position in the list of wheat exporting
countries?
Indo-Pakistan trade
3109. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that trade between
India and Pakistan is adversely affected
because of the suspension of train services
between the two countries;
(b) if so, the commodities exported from
